_expect.name: Tubbs Hill Cave and Warm Up Boulders

id_tubbs_hill_cave_and_warm_up_boulders.blurb: A small bouldering zone on Tubbs Hill, the wooded peninsula park right beside downtown Coeur d'Alene and the lake. Eleven problems cluster here: a vertical warm-up boulder sits up the slope, with the cave boulders directly beneath it. The spread is wide for so few problems, from a couple of easy V1s through the middle grades to a handful of very hard lines topping out around V10, so strong boulderers and newer climbers both find something. The hill is a busy walking route, so expect hikers passing close to the base, and keep an eye on foot traffic below you when you are on the wall.

id_duke_complex_the.blurb: A cluster of small towers tucked away in the South Hills section of Castle Rocks, a short hike beyond the main parking area and a bit north-west of True Grit Tower. Ten routes wrap around several sides of the towers, mixing trad lines with a few bolted ones and top-rope setups. Difficulty runs from easy 5.6 up to about 5.11, with half of the routes landing in the 5.10 range, so it suits a mixed party better than a pure beginner outing. The setting is quiet and secluded, with both sunny and shaded faces to pick between depending on the day's temperature.
